name: How long does grout repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does grout repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of grout repair depends on the size of the area, the extent of the damage, and the type of grout being used. Minor repairs on small sections might be completed within a few hours. Larger areas, or those requiring extensive grout removal and replacement, could take a full day or sometimes longer. The curing time for new grout also needs to be factored in; while you might be able to lightly use the area after 24 hours, it typically takes 48-72 hours for grout to fully cure and for sealants to dry completely. A professional assessment will provide a more accurate time estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout repair duration varies based on project size and damage, from a few hours for minor fixes to a full day or more for larger areas, plus curing time.
